name: Shortwave
tagline: AI-powered email client with search and summarization for Gmail
painPoints: Gmail-only; no support for Outlook or other providers
AI features are within the email client, not proactive or cross-tool
Cannot create tasks from email or manage calendar directly
Relatively new; feature set still maturing compared to Superhuman
Requires switching from Gmail's native interface
metaDescription: Looking for a Shortwave alternative? GAIA is source-available AI that triages email, manages tasks, and runs workflows across your tools. Free tier included.
whyPeopleLook: Shortwave brings AI to Gmail with smart summaries, pinned threads, and fast search. It is a thoughtfully designed product but it remains an email client, its AI intelligence does not extend to your calendar, tasks, or other tools. Users who want their AI to manage more than just their inbox find that Shortwave is a stepping stone rather than a destination.
gaiaReplaces: Priority inbox identification with proactive surfacing
Task creation from email without leaving your workflow
Calendar event scheduling from email content
Cross-tool AI that connects email to tasks and meetings
gaiaAdvantages: Proactive cross-tool intelligence beyond what an email client can provide
Tasks and calendar integrated natively alongside email
Works from any interface: web, desktop, mobile, CLI, and bots
Source-available and self-hostable for privacy-conscious users
Free tier available without interface lock-in
migrationSteps: Connect GAIA directly to Gmail via OAuth, use Gmail's native interface alongside
Configure GAIA's inbox monitoring for proactive email surfacing
Enable email-to-task creation for action-requiring threads
Link Google Calendar for complete inbox-to-calendar automation

faqs.question: Does GAIA replace the Gmail interface like Shortwave?
faqs.answer: GAIA does not replace the Gmail interface. It works alongside Gmail, managing your inbox proactively and taking actions on your behalf. You can continue using Gmail's UI while GAIA handles the intelligent layer.

faqs.question: Can GAIA summarize emails like Shortwave?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can summarize email threads, generate daily inbox digests, and provide contextual summaries of important conversations, with the added ability to create tasks and calendar events from those summaries.

faqs.question: Is GAIA better for productivity than Shortwave?
faqs.answer: For end-to-end productivity, email plus calendar plus tasks plus automation, GAIA is more capable. Shortwave is better if you primarily want a polished email client with smart features.

faqs.question: Does GAIA have IMAP/SMTP support like an email client?
faqs.answer: GAIA connects to Gmail via the Gmail API rather than IMAP/SMTP. It is not an email client but an AI layer on top of your existing email account.

comparisonRows.gaia: Upgrade from a smarter inbox to a full workload manager across email, calendar, tasks, and the rest of your tools
comparisonRows.competitor: AI-enhanced email client built on Gmail: adds intelligent writing, summarization, and inbox automation to your existing email workflow

comparisonRows.gaia: Same Gmail-native depth plus autonomous execution: triage, drafts, labels, tasks, and inbox-zero flows
comparisonRows.competitor: Deep email-native AI: instant AI reply drafts, tone adjustment, thread summarization, natural-language custom filters, smart snooze, and AI-powered search across your entire email history

comparisonRows.gaia: Replies drafted from memory of conversations, tasks, and calendar, with urgent mail routed to action
comparisonRows.competitor: Learns your personal writing style to generate personalized drafts; AI editor refines length, tone, and language; autocomplete suggestions while composing; AI-generated scheduling emails

comparisonRows.gaia: Dedicated todo system with projects, priorities, and semantic search, fed by email automatically
comparisonRows.competitor: Can create tasks and reminders from email threads, but task management is not a core product surface: no dedicated task view, projects, or priorities

comparisonRows.gaia: Events managed and briefings generated autonomously, beyond composing with availability checks
comparisonRows.competitor: AI-generated scheduling emails and one-click calendar event creation from email threads; checks availability when composing; does not manage events or generate meeting briefings autonomously

comparisonRows.gaia: Natural-language workflows across email, calendar, Slack, Notion, GitHub, Linear, Todoist, and the rest of your tools
comparisonRows.competitor: Integrates with Slack, Notion, Asana, HubSpot, and Linear for contextual actions from within email threads; no general-purpose workflow automation engine

comparisonRows.gaia: A knowledge graph of your work built over time, connecting tasks, meetings, people, and outcomes
comparisonRows.competitor: Learns your writing style and facts about you from emails you send to personalize reply drafts; no cross-tool knowledge graph or persistent behavioral memory

comparisonRows.gaia: Bi-directional depth across your tools via MCP, not email-centric contextual actions
comparisonRows.competitor: Connects with Slack, Notion, Asana, HubSpot, Linear, and others for contextual email actions; integrations are email-centric rather than broadly bi-directional

comparisonRows.gaia: Web, desktop, CLI, and Discord, Slack, and Telegram bots, with no interface lock-in
comparisonRows.competitor: Web app, iOS app, and Android app; no desktop app, CLI, or bot interfaces

comparisonRows.gaia: Inspect and self-host the code with Docker, owning your data entirely
comparisonRows.competitor: Closed-source proprietary platform; data processed by Shortwave and its AI providers; no self-hosting option
